notes.title: Major Update - RTS Rework - Alpha phase
notes.content:
[p][b]Major RTS Rework Update[/b][/p][p]A lot of changes are happening with the RTS rework — from logic to visuals... pretty much everything has changed![/p][p]You can participate in the [b]alpha testing[/b] by applying on Discord.
You'll get access to the [b]alpha testing branch[/b] and be able to test it live and give feedback.
There won't be a tutorial yet, so I still recommend playing the current demo if systems like mining aren't clear in your mind.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 About the Changes:[/h3][p][b]RTS Interior & 3D Model Improvements[/b]
Every asset has been updated. The ship's interior looks much better, and the scaling has been greatly improved.[/p][p][b]Streamlined Resources[/b]
No more individual resources for each mineral. Instead, there are now [b]4 main mineral types[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Raw Metal[/p][/*][*][p]Raw Crystal[/p][/*][*][p]Raw Gas[/p][/*][*][p]Raw Unstable[/p][/*][/list][p]And one more:
[b]Nanite[/b] – Who knows what it does...?[/p][p][b]Modules Rework[/b]
Modules now have [b]only one function[/b] — no more recipe lists or choices.
They will keep producing as long as they are powered on.[/p][p][b]New Storage Logic[/b]
You can now assign a [b]target resource[/b] for each storage module.
Only [b]one resource[/b] can be assigned at a time, allowing you to better organize what goes where.[/p][p][b]New UI System[/b]
Modules now display [b]interactive UI overlays[/b] showing:[/p][list][*][p]Power status[/p][/*][*][p]Storage activity[/p][/*][*][p]Operational state[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Building & Recycling Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Building[/b] now requires resources to be delivered before construction begins.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recycling[/b] involves a module emptying itself first, then entering a destruction phase where it returns a portion of its building materials.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Visuals[/b]
Tons of visual updates!
Road connections, placement confirmations, and more now reflect a [b]true RTS vibe[/b].[/p][p][b]Tech Researches[/b]
All tech is [b]fully unlocked by default[/b] for now, as the research system is still under development.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 Up Next:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Space Station[/b] (at least a functioning [b]Hangar[/b] to allow ship upgrades and loadout customization)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early PvE[/b] — basic enemies and environmental challenges[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New RTS Visuals Sneak Peak
notes.content:
[p]Major Update - 0.5.0 Announcement. 

 [b]Logistic & Module Placement Rework Incoming[/b]  A quick look at what’s coming — aiming for alpha testing in the next weeks.  

[b]Resource & Production Changes:[/b] The game has too many resources, even at Tier 1. It feels bloated, and crafting was taking too much of the spotlight. So I’m streamlining it. Key changes: 

[b]• Unified resource types[/b] Mining Iron, Copper, or Nickel now gives you Raw Metal. Only the amount you get will vary — same idea for Crystals, Gases, and Unstable materials. 

[b]• New rare material: Nanite[/b] Nanite is a mysterious substance you might randomly extract. No one knows where it comes from, but it's tied to the story. 

[b]• Simplified recipes[/b] Instead of tons of plates and ingots, recipes will use broad components like: 
Structural Components[/p][list][*][p]Structural Components[/p][/*][*][p]Electrical Components 
[/p][/*][/list][p][b] • Production module rework[/b] 

Each module will now only handle 1 or 2 recipes max. Think of how Fuel Modules work now — less menu clutter, more focus on base-building.  

[b]Module Placement Overhaul[/b] 
The RTS building system is getting a full usability pass. What’s changing: 

[b]
• Smoother placement & navigation[/b][/p][p][b]• Better visual feedback[/b][/p][p][b]• Full mouse support[/b][/p][p][b]• Tutorial Revamp[/b]  [/p][p]Once the above is in, I’ll be reworking the tutorial completely. Proper steps with trigger conditions. Focus will start on RTS gameplay while Mining, ship gameplay, and deeper systems will come after. [/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for now! Should be ready for testing very soon and as such, I'll open a channel on the discord where people can apply to become alpha testers.

 [url="https://https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=9_aUwXibHbWnKNb5&v=mNOS3yPbA9s&feature=youtu.be" style="button"]Check out the video[/url][/p]
